source_text: No accepted family boundary distinguishes Event Detail primary/companion/previews from related EventCard, mobile listing media, and the lab-only rail.
required_evidence: Owner receipt classifies every boundary-pending consumer without merge/split inference.

actual_evidence.finding: The immutable decoder names only DesktopEventPage as a production consumer; EventMediaRail appears only as an additional source binding.
actual_evidence.limitation: The decoder does not classify the complete family boundary.

actual_evidence.finding: The same route mounts DesktopEventPage, EventHero, related EventCard feed and PersonalFeedSlot.
actual_evidence.limitation: Reachability does not decide component identity.

actual_evidence.finding: EventHero, DesktopEventActionPanel, EventCard and EventCtaPanel also supply distinct share-media semantics.
actual_evidence.limitation: Source-wiring tests do not accept a shared Event Media boundary.

actual_evidence.finding: Adjacent EventCard and listing-rail consumers are captured.
actual_evidence.limitation: Both packets are candidate runtime and production_state_claimed=false.

residual_risk: A completed inventory can still misclassify semantic media modes and composition placements as one component identity; required Search, listing, Personal Feed, Favorites, collection, festival, club, artifact and share/social surfaces remain dependent on the full R01 census and cannot be silently merged.

source_text: 4:5, 5:4, 3:2, 2:3, 1:1, intrinsic/source and other observed ratios are not positively bound or explicitly non-applicable for every accepted consumer.
required_evidence: Every accepted consumer/slot ratio cell is reconciled without selecting a global target ratio.

actual_evidence.finding: Compact card and mobile-listing policies positively use horizontal 5:4.
actual_evidence.limitation: These are consumer-local rules, not Event Detail or global ratio authority.

actual_evidence.finding: Share media requires 1200x630, 1080x1350 and 1080x1080 outputs.
actual_evidence.limitation: Share canvas ratios do not bind Event Detail frames.

actual_evidence.finding: Event Detail admits intrinsic/arbitrary ratios and threshold buckets.
actual_evidence.limitation: Observed AS-IS geometry is not an accepted per-slot ratio contract.

actual_evidence.finding: 4:5 and 5:4 are visually captured.
actual_evidence.limitation: The evidence belongs to adjacent candidate consumers outside the tentative Event Detail boundary.

residual_risk: Source orientation, rendered frame, share canvas and consumer placement can be conflated; repeated values must not create a global ratio token.

source_text: Photography, poster/artwork, OCR/document, unknown-text and classified non-photo document behavior is not reconciled across Desktop, EventHero and EventMediaRail.
required_evidence: Every accepted consumer binds all media types with no source/requirement conflict.

actual_evidence.finding: Media role, text mode and geometry fields exist.
actual_evidence.limitation: Field presence is upstream vocabulary, not reconciled consumer behavior.

actual_evidence.finding: The V12 requirement separates visual photography, OCR/unknown media, classified non-photo documents and identity-poster companions.
actual_evidence.limitation: Current renderers do not consistently enforce every row.

actual_evidence.finding: Desktop and mobile fit are driven mainly by image_text_mode while media_role is carried separately.
actual_evidence.limitation: A visual_only classified non-photo role can still follow the photo-cover branch.

actual_evidence.finding: The rail slices assets and renders thumbnails.
actual_evidence.limitation: It exposes no semantic mode or role-specific policy.

actual_evidence.finding: Controlled rail anatomy is captured.
actual_evidence.limitation: It is AS-IS controlled runtime with production_state_claimed=false.

residual_risk: A classified program, map or sponsor document can still be treated as photography; poster identity and text mode remain non-equivalent axes.

source_text: Focal point, safe area, crop permission and object-position are not one proven policy; metadata exists but focal/safe data does not gate current cover.
required_evidence: Covered media has a consumer-specific, positively evidenced crop/safe/focal rule or explicit non-applicability.

actual_evidence.finding: Focal point, valuable region, safe_crop, object-position and pixel-current provenance fields exist.
actual_evidence.limitation: The fields alone do not prove renderer enforcement.

actual_evidence.finding: The standalone protected-crop solver is tested and fails closed.
actual_evidence.limitation: This does not prove EventHero or DesktopEventPage calls the solver.

actual_evidence.finding: Tests inspect Hero/Desktop source patterns.
actual_evidence.limitation: They explicitly show the large renderers do not call resolveEventImageCrop for a fixed target.

actual_evidence.finding: Cover consumes a precomputed object position.
actual_evidence.limitation: safe_crop and protected regions do not gate current cover.

actual_evidence.finding: Requirements document both safe-metadata gating and a deliberate visual-only cover exception.
actual_evidence.limitation: The consumer-local exception is not reconciled into one accepted policy.

residual_risk: Metadata presence or standalone solver tests can be mistaken for renderer enforcement; faces, meaningful text and safe regions may still be cropped.

source_text: No accepted upscale ceiling exists, and EventHero low-resolution containment is logically unreachable.
required_evidence: A tested consumer-specific tiny/upscale policy replaces the contradictory branch without introducing a ratio token.

actual_evidence.finding: Admission uses 720 long edge, 450000 area and score 10; weak originals survive without a strong alternative.
actual_evidence.limitation: There is no maximum rendered-to-source scale.

actual_evidence.finding: primaryLowResolutionPortrait requires a non-visual mode before calling a helper that can return true only for visual-only photo-like media.
actual_evidence.limitation: The containment branch is logically unreachable.

actual_evidence.finding: The helper is unit-tested and the Hero test finds data attributes and CSS selectors.
actual_evidence.limitation: The Hero test never executes the contradictory caller predicate.

actual_evidence.finding: A tiny-source state is reviewed.
actual_evidence.limitation: It is candidate runtime at 1728x900 and production_state_claimed=false.

actual_evidence.finding: History records intent to preserve low-resolution portrait media and curate quality.
actual_evidence.limitation: Commit intent is not proof of current reachable behavior.

residual_risk: Source-pattern tests preserve a logically dead mobile branch and no consumer has an accepted maximum rendered-to-source scale.

source_text: Missing fallback exists, but broken-image convergence is unproven for Event Detail primary, companion, gallery and previews.
required_evidence: Missing and broken states have tested consumer-specific semantic convergence and preserved geometry.

actual_evidence.finding: Typed concert/lecture missing fallback is 1280x1280, contained and decorative.
actual_evidence.limitation: This is missing-source behavior, not broken-image convergence.

actual_evidence.finding: A missing Event Detail state is reviewed.
actual_evidence.limitation: It is candidate runtime and not production-equivalent.

actual_evidence.finding: Load/error geometry convergence is asserted for recommendation EventCard and continuation.
actual_evidence.limitation: It does not cover Event Detail primary, companion, gallery or previews.

actual_evidence.finding: Mobile listing loading and error are visually indistinguishable.
actual_evidence.limitation: This is a conflict, not semantic convergence.

actual_evidence.finding: Broken ListingEventCard exposes the browser marker and multi-line alt overflow.
actual_evidence.limitation: The observed failure is adjacent evidence and remains unresolved.

residual_risk: A valid missing state can mask broken-source failures; primary, companion, gallery and preview failures can leak browser UI, alt overflow or geometry changes.

source_text: Mobile primary/poster reservation and genuine lazy gallery loading treatment are incomplete; skeleton applicability is not adjudicated for every slot.
required_evidence: Every slot proves reservation and either a genuine loading state or a reasoned SSG non-applicability.

actual_evidence.finding: The charter requires deterministic reservation/loading reasoning and forbids an artificial SSG skeleton.
actual_evidence.limitation: Each Event Detail slot still needs an applicability decision.

actual_evidence.finding: The primary is eager and gallery images are lazy with dimensions.
actual_evidence.limitation: No accepted visible gallery loading/recovery state is bound.

actual_evidence.finding: Skeleton and layout reservation are tested for continuation cards.
actual_evidence.limitation: Adjacent continuation behavior cannot be copied to Event Detail media slots.

actual_evidence.finding: An adjacent listing loading/error pair is captured.
actual_evidence.limitation: It is not an Event Detail slot and the phases are visually indistinguishable.

residual_risk: Unrelated continuation-card skeleton tests can be credited to Event Detail; lazy gallery states can remain transient, unowned or layout-shifting.

source_text: No complete responsive art-direction contract exists; primary media lacks alternate-source art direction and nine Desktop cascade probes are unreconciled.
required_evidence: All required responsive cells are reconciled and all nine probes have terminal positive evidence or exact accepted non-applicability.

actual_evidence.finding: The route switches separate desktop/mobile DOM at 1024px.
actual_evidence.limitation: A DOM split is not alternate-source media art direction.

actual_evidence.finding: Media queries at 1024, 1200 and 1440 are extracted.
actual_evidence.limitation: Source extraction does not prove the compiled consumer cascade.

actual_evidence.finding: All nine exact probes are present.
actual_evidence.limitation: Every probe has terminal_status=MISMATCH because no affected compiled selector resolved in the exact consumer.

actual_evidence.finding: The historical source-extraction gap is superseded.
actual_evidence.limitation: The dossier explicitly retains EM-RESP-008 for semantic/cascade reconciliation.

residual_risk: Extracted breakpoint fields can be misread as rendered cascade or alternate-source art-direction evidence while all nine exact probes remain mismatches.

source_text: All relevant supplement captures are candidate or controlled runtime; none is production-equivalent or production-observed.
required_evidence: Exact production route/consumer runtime evidence is reviewed and positively bound.

actual_evidence.finding: All five relevant packets are captured and reviewed.
actual_evidence.limitation: Every packet has production_state_claimed=false and reachability candidate-runtime or controlled-exact-component-runtime.

actual_evidence.finding: The supplement provides controlled media evidence.
actual_evidence.limitation: No exact desktop or mobile fullscreen Event Detail packet exists.

actual_evidence.finding: The immutable evidence scope is source-only-until-reconciled.
actual_evidence.limitation: It cannot establish production runtime.

actual_evidence.finding: Historical public and lab acceptance is documented.
actual_evidence.limitation: It is not positively bound as exact current production-equivalent evidence for every consumer and state.

residual_risk: Source, tests, historical review screenshots and controlled candidate captures can be mislabeled as production observation; fullscreen and failure paths remain unobserved.

source_text: Human review remains pending, normalization is disallowed, recommendation is unresolved and no owner decision receipt exists.
required_evidence: A separate accepted receipt resolves review, recommendation and normalization permission without mutating immutable evidence.

actual_evidence.finding: human_review_status is pending.
actual_evidence.limitation: No accepted review receipt exists.

actual_evidence.finding: normalization_allowed is false.
actual_evidence.limitation: The immutable candidate forbids normalization.

actual_evidence.finding: recommendation is unresolved.
actual_evidence.limitation: A new dossier recommendation cannot mutate this evidence.

actual_evidence.finding: decision_accepted is false and contract/boundary decisions are null.
actual_evidence.limitation: No owner receipt exists.

residual_risk: A candidate recommendation or complete JSON dossier can be promoted as accepted authority without a separate owner receipt.

source_text: Lab-only EventMediaRail covers OCR/documents and lacks broken/missing/tiny plus overflow/keyboard closure.
required_evidence: Owner excludes it with reason or reconciles semantics and runtime without promoting lab evidence as production.

actual_evidence.finding: The component emits intrinsic thumbnails, srcset and preview buttons.
actual_evidence.limitation: It has no semantic-mode fit, fallback, broken, tiny, overflow or keyboard contract.

actual_evidence.finding: A controlled exact rail capture is reviewed.
actual_evidence.limitation: production_state_claimed=false.

actual_evidence.finding: The ledger records the EventMediaRail shelf.
actual_evidence.limitation: keyboard_alternative and overflow_contract are unresolved; runtime_status is planned-not-captured.

actual_evidence.finding: The rail is currently evidence_only_preserve.
actual_evidence.limitation: That field is not an accepted owner exclusion receipt.

residual_risk: Treating evidence_only_preserve as an accepted exclusion would close by field presence; inclusion instead reopens semantic, error, overflow and keyboard work.

source_text: Historical dossier has global provenance lists, not reconciled source + requirement + runtime evidence per consumer cell.
required_evidence: Every accepted cell has resolvable source and requirement evidence plus runtime evidence or an explicit reasoned absence.

actual_evidence.finding: Historical v1 stores global evidence lists.
actual_evidence.limitation: It does not bind evidence to consumer cells.

actual_evidence.finding: V1.1 adds consumer cells and evidence fields.
actual_evidence.limitation: Many cells remain CONFLICT, UNBOUND or PARTIAL_EVIDENCE; runtime refs are empty on several rows and all target decisions are null.

actual_evidence.finding: Runtime rows are addressable by stable IDs.
actual_evidence.limitation: Available media packets explicitly deny production-state claims.

actual_evidence.finding: Some current tests establish source fields and branch text.
actual_evidence.limitation: Regex source assertions are not consumer runtime evidence.

residual_risk: Schema completeness can be mistaken for evidence sufficiency; generic, historical or non-production refs can be copied across consumer cells.
